item.title: Council Seeking Contractor For €400k Hazardous Waste Services

item.title: Gardaí Warning Of Potentially Fatal Consequences Of Drink Driving This Weekend
item.description: Gardaí in Clare are warning motorists of the potentially fatal consequences of drink driving this weekend.
